One of the hardest parts of building an AI company is realizing that intelligence without memory isn’t enough.

Imagine a founder tells Melcor.ai:

“Payments are not part of the first version.”

Then comes back a few days later and asks:

“Should we add Stripe now?”

The AI team shouldn’t forget the original decision, contradict the founder, or make them explain the entire project again.

That’s why we built selective long-term memory into Melcor.ai.

Almost no one knows which orchestration framework to use 

Here’s how to stop winging it :

⭕️ Use n8n when:

 • You’re integrating LLMs with tools
 • Your flow is trigger → AI → action
 • You want fast, no-code deployment
 • You don’t need agent memory

 ⭕️ Use LangGraph when:

 • Your agents need to think, loop, reflect
 • You want memory + state across steps
 • You’re building logic trees, retries, branching 
  paths
 • You need observability
